title: GameMaker Library: Pegfall added, 82 assets
body:
Pegfall is in the GameMaker Library from today, new here first: it has no page of its own yet. That makes 82 assets on this page. If you own the library, download again from your itch.io library at no extra cost: the whole library holds it in the folder for minigames and game modes, and the download named NEW 2026-11-07: Pegfall only holds Pegfall alone, so you only download what changed.

What Pegfall is

  • A complete peg board shooter in pure GML. Boards are generated from a seed by ten layout grammars in six drawn themes, and every board is proven clearable before your game gets it.
  • An aim guide that runs the shot's own physics, so the dotted line is where the ball goes.
  • A moving bucket, a score multiplier, three powers, a slow zoom on the last target and a five slot fever finish.
  • Every peg is drawn and lit in four bead materials. Target, bonus and power pegs differ by shape as well as colour. No sprite art ships: the board is drawn in code.
  • A runnable demo room, THE PARLOUR, with every theme, layout and power on a key, and an in engine test suite.

It is the first of three Arcade Cabinet minigames. The next two join here the same way, on their launch day.

The library now holds 82 assets worth $1,053.18 bought one by one, for $19.99; 19 of them are minigames and game modes. Every new asset joins on its launch day. Try the free sampler, Drawn in Code, and if the library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Made with AI tools: the code and the store images.
